title: Changelog - July 2019
content:
## Changelog - July 2019


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000093689

New Features:

- We added the ability to set different images to be used as the Invoice Logo and Email Template Logo.  In order to use this new feature navigate to the Admin >> Settings >> General Settings >>Brand Images.

- We added the ability to select which members can view each single "Web Page" when the site is set to be Members Only . Note: This feature is available when the Member-Only Content Add-On is active. In order to use this feature, navigate to the Admin >> Content >> Edit Web Pages >> Display Settings.

- We added the ability to change the default sort order of member searches on the frontend of sites.  They can now be sorted by Date Posted (Most Recent First, Most Recent Last) or Random. In order to use this new feature, navigate to the Admin >> Content >> Edit Post Settings >>Review >> Search Results Design tab.

- We added the ability to export the Sales History records of the Sell Digital Downloads Add-On.

- We created a new Design Setting that allows the Admin to hide the Homepage Divider on mobile devices. In order to use this new setting, navigate to the Admin >> Settings >> Design Settings >> Homepage Layout tab >> Homepage Divider Settings.

- We added "Top + Sub + Sub-Sub Member Category" as a new Sidebar Search Module widget.

- We added a new option to the "Account Status After Signup" Product Level setting called "On hold, Requires Admin Approval". Choosing this setting will apply the status "On Hold" to all members that signup for this Product, and an Admin of the site will have to manually set the member's status to "Active" before they will appear on the site.

- We created a new Design Setting to display Profile Photos as circular instead of rectangular on the frontend of a site. In order to use this new feature, navigate to the Admin >> Settings >> Design Settings >> Design Settings tab >> Additional Design Settings section.

- We improved the logic of the "Member Related Search" widget that shows in the sidebar of profile pages to prevent it from adding links that will lead to non-existent pages when the member enters a custom city name not recognized by Google Maps.

- We released the Predictive Keyword Search Add-On. Click here for more information.

- We added the "Customize Page Level Footer Content" field to the Edit Web pages area in the Admin. Whatever code is added to this field will be added to the page immediately above the closing </body> tag of the page

- We added support for using Skype, Tel, Mail To and External Links in Menu Item URL fields in the Admin >> Menu Manager.

- We added "Top + Sub + Sub-Sub Member Category" as a new Homepage Search widget option.

- We created a new Design Setting in order to show/hide the number of posts in each tab on Member Profile Pages. In order to use this new feature, navigate to the Admin >> Settings >> Design Settings >> Design Settings tab >> Additional Design Settings section.

- We added the ability to show/hide the Member Address information on Member Search Results pages based on the "Show Address on Listing" Product Setting.

Enhancements / Fixes:

- We fixed an issue which was causing the "Email Accounts" link in the Admin to result in a 404 error in some cases.

- We fixed an issue which was preventing Form Inquiries from being deleted in the Admin.

- We fixed an issue that was preventing the Overview tab from displaying on member profile pages when the "Hide Map Overview Tab" Product setting was set to "yes".

- We fixed an issue which was causing leads to be matched with the incorrect member in some cases.

- We fixed an issue which was causing the browser back button to not work properly after performing a member search using the  "Top and Sub Category Search" widget on the homepage.

- We improved the load time of the "Search Members" page in the Admin.

- Sub-Sub categories will now be displayed under their parent Sub category on the "Services" tab on member profile pages.

- Products set to be "Non-Searchable" will no longer appear in the "Recent Members" homepage widget options on the Design Settings page in the Admin.

- We updated the search functionality of the "Edit Web Pages" and "SEO Template" pages in the Admin.

- We fixed an issue which was causing a redirect loop when switching between the Admin of different sites using the Safari browser.

- We updated the Design Settings in the Admin to only show the "Homepage Section Order Options" of items set to display in the "Homepage Section Order".

- We fixed an issue which was causing Banner Ad Widgets to not work on individual Web Pages.

- The system will now automatically create a 301 redirect for the /reviews and /connect pages of a member's profile page when the URL of their profile pages is updated.

- We fixed an issue which was preventing manual billing subscriptions for members from being started from the Admin  in some cases.

- We updated the Private Member Chat Add-On to show the member you are chatting with in each thread when viewing your threads in the Member Dashboard.

- We fixed an issue which was preventing the Event Date Picker field from work properly when the date format is set to "DD/MM/YY" and the Auto-Recurring Events Add-On is active.

- We fixed an issue that was causing member searches for subcategories to not show accurate results using some member search widgets.

- We fixed an issue which was preventing Admins from deleting invoices in Admin Area in some cases.

- We added the Jordanian Dinar as an available website currency.

- We fixed an issue which was causing settings for the Easy Coupon Codes Add-On to be reset after saving a Product in the Admin in some cases.

- We fixed an issue that was affecting the ability to select the "State" field when adding a new Contact in the Admin.

- We updated the display of titles in the Recent Reviews sidebar widget to allow the text to break when it is too long to display in a single line.

- We fixed an issue which was preventing the Member Categories Search Filter fields on search results pages from loading correctly in some cases.

- We fixed an issue which was preventing the "Filter By Form" field on the Form Inquiries page in the Admin from displaying options when there was only 1 form to filter by.

- We fixed an issue that was preventing the "getMemberSubCategory" function from returning results when "all" was set as the second parameter when calling the function.

- We added formatting to the Lead Count number shown in the Admin Sidebar.

- We fixed an issue which was preventing the system from including the Menu CSS Class field when Cloning an existent menu.

- We fixed an issue which was preventing logging in as a Member from the Leads page in the Admin from working properly.

- We fixed an issue which was affecting the Member Keyword search feature when the "Member Keyword Search Type" setting in the General Settings was set as "Inclusive".

- We removed the "Deleted Selected" button from the Reviews and Leads pages in the Admin and added it as an option in the "Bulk Actions" dropdown on these pages instead.

- We fixed an issue which was causing the Leads search engine to show 0 suggested matches on the Lead Details page in the Admin in some cases.

- We fixed an issue that was preventing multiple different forms from printing within the same widget or same body content of Single Static pages.

- We added more detailed error messages when forms aren't able to be submitted on the frontend of sites.

- We fixed an issue with the Sitemap Generator Add-On which was preventing URLs with a State in them from being added in some cases.

- We disabled the "Can View" checkbox on the Post Publishing tab in the Product Settings when a Post Type has the "Members-Only Access" setting set to "Keep Public for All Visitors".

- We fixed an issue which was affecting the ability to search for events using the "Select Date" field in some cases.

- The "Profile Photo Title" text label in the Member Dashboard will now be highlighted when viewing the text labels on that page as an Admin.

- The affiliate tracking code added through the General Settings or the "Bootstrap Theme - Conversion Tracking Codes" widget will now be executed when a member upgrades their account as well as when they first sign up.

- We fixed an issue which was preventing the font selected for the site from applying to the Bookmark Counter.

- We fixed an issue with the Private Member Chat Add-On text field background not matching with the Theme Color Sets in some cases.

- We fixed an issue which was causing text added in the Highlight Member Results Add-On to not be updated correctly when saved in some cases.

- The Copyright symbol and Terms of Use and Privacy Policy links found in the footer of sites by default have been moved from the Footer Widget to the Footer Menu for new sites moving forward to make them more easily accessible.

- We fixed an issue that was causing field validation on Checkout pages to not work properly when more than one form was printed in the same widget or Web Page body.

- We fixed an issue that was affecting the ability to delete members in bulk from the Admin in some cases.

- We updated the Stripe Payment Gateway integration to send all Credit Card information to Stripe in a better organized format. This will make payments easier to identify when logged in to a Stripe account.  Also, we updated the "Member - Sign Up - Paid" form in order to only use a single field for the "Name on Card" rather than a "First Name" and "Last Name" field which is not compatible with all name formats that may appear on credit cards.

- We fixed an issue which was causing the system 2 show two duplicate "processing" alerts after saving a change to a Sidebar in the Admin.

- We fixed an issue which was causing the system to show an error message when trying to pay an invoice from the Member Dashboard.

- We fixed an issue that was causing the Footer Newsletter form to be erroneously pre-populated with a Contact's email address in some cases.

- We fixed an issue with the UI of the Froala WYSIWYG when adding a link to content on the "Edit Web Pages" area in the Admin.

- We fixed an issue which was causing the "Bookmark my Favorites" Add-On to not display any data in the Member Dashboard when a member saves a Listing as a Favorite.

- We fixed an issue which was preventing the Payfast Payment Gateway from processing transactions in some cases.

- We removed redundant code from the Listing Feature Search Results to improve the efficiency of loading member search results pages.

- We fixed an issue which was erroneously causing the Lead Form to show an "Invalid Recaptcha" error when submitting the form in some cases.

- We fixed an issue with the "Members-Only Access" Post Settings which was causing the search results pages of post types to be Members-Only when it was set to only make the details pages of posts to be Members-Only.

- In all, over 80 feature enhancements and software updates were released this month.
